Main sprite clearly reads as a red/pink heart with two lobes, central notch and lower point inside the cream speech balloon; the small gold excitement ticks remain separate and purposeful. Interior breathing room keeps the heart clear at game size.

Runtime smile remains a joyful golden-yellow round face with two curved closed happy eyes, two rosy cheeks and a broad open smiling mouth. Eye, cheek and mouth shapes remain separated at intended game size; no heart substitution or ambiguous emotion.

Heart and smile share compatible warm ivory/gold/brown material, soft highlight language, rounded balloon/tail treatment and excitement ticks while preserving their distinct red/pink versus golden symbol palettes. Useful proportion changes are acceptable.
